name: in.forevervow/forevervow
title: ForeverVow
description: Free Indian wedding invites: pick a design and get a prefilled invite website, video and PDF link.

tools.name: list_designs
tools.description: List ForeverVow's Indian wedding invitation designs (free and premium), each with a short description and a sample invite link. Use it to help the couple choose a design before create_invite.

style.description: Optional filter: Rajasthani designs or other Indian designs.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Make a free Indian wedding invite on ForeverVow with the couple's names and functions (haldi, mehendi, sangeet, wedding, reception…). Returns a link that opens the finished draft in the ForeverVow editor, where the couple can change anything, add photos, an RSVP page and a song, then publish one link to share on WhatsApp and download a free MP4 video and PDF. Ask for any missing names, dates, times or venues first; nothing is published until the couple presses Publish.

design.description: Design key from list_designs, e.g. "palace", "raj-haveli". Defaults to "palace".

functions.description: Each function in order. Times are local (India) time.

tools.name: get_invitation_messages
tools.description: Ready-to-send wedding invitation messages for WhatsApp in English, Hindi and Hinglish (formal, warm, for friends, reminder). Replace the sample names, date and city with the couple's.
